ns2:course.label: Lab Rotation I
ns2:course.description: Laboratory research methods; familiarization of first-year graduate students with experimental methods used in research in Biophysics and Computational Biology. Required of all first-year students majoring in Biophysics and Computational Biology. First five weeks of fall term. Prerequisite: First-year graduate status and consent of department; concurrent registration in BIOP 582 and BIOP 583.
